## Summary

- Adds `quartz/components/Transcript.tsx`: a collapsible `<details>` block that renders episode captions with EN/ZH language tab toggle
- Reads `captionEn` and `captionZh` frontmatter paths at build time via `allFiles` lookup — no runtime fetch needed
- Shows tabs only when both languages exist; gracefully renders nothing when neither frontmatter field is set
- Exports `Transcript` from `quartz/components/index.ts`
- Registers the component in `quartz.layout.ts` `afterBody` for episode pages (before Comments)
- Creates `content/captions/.gitkeep` to track the captions directory (populated by the upcoming caption-workflow)

## Frontmatter convention (opt-in, no existing files modified)

```yaml
captionEn: /captions/ep01.en.md
captionZh: /captions/ep01.zh.md
```

## Test plan

- [ ] Verify no TypeScript errors in layout or component files
- [ ] Build site locally; episode pages with no caption frontmatter render normally (Transcript block absent)
- [ ] After caption-workflow PR merges, add `captionEn`/`captionZh` to an episode and confirm transcript renders with correct tab switching

Closes #40

## AI Review Synthesis > Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**. > Requested by @lolipopshock. ## Summary of PR/Issue PR #41 adds the first half of a bilingual caption system for the Augmented Mind podcast site (closes #40). It introduces `Transcript.tsx`, a collapsible `
` component that reads `captionEn`/`captionZh` frontmatter paths at Quartz build time, resolves them against `allFiles`, and renders a tab-switched EN/ZH UI. The component is registered in `quartz.layout.ts` behind the existing `isEpisodePage` guard, exported cleanly from `index.ts`, and a `content/captions/.gitkeep` placeholder is added for the forthcoming caption-workflow PR. This is the round 5 re-review after a fix-pr pass addressed four prior action items. ## Review Three of four round-4 action items were correctly resolved, but the fix for the index-pollution warning introduced a new blocking defect: adding `"captions"` to `ignorePatterns` prevents caption files from ever appearing in `allFiles`, making the `Transcript` component permanently render nothing. The fix is a one-line revert. | Issue | Severity | Description | | -- | -- | -- | | `ignorePatterns: ["captions"]` silently breaks Transcript | BLOCKING | Caption files excluded at the glob stage never reach `allFiles`; `findText` always returns `null` and the component renders nothing for any episode with caption frontmatter set. | | Incomplete ARIA tab pattern | INFO | `tabindex="0"` on each `role="tabpanel"` and `aria-labelledby` pointing to the controlling tab `id` are missing per WAI-ARIA APG; usable but short of the full pattern. | | Dead-code dark-mode CSS override | INFO | `:root[saved-theme="dark"] .transcript { border-color: var(--lightgray) }` duplicates the default rule value; CSS custom properties already resolve to palette values automatically. | | Hand-rolled `pathToSlug` | INFO | `path.replace(/^\//, "").replace(/\.md$/, "")` duplicates Quartz's `simplifySlug(slugifyFilePath(path))`; low urgency since paths are machine-generated and the logic is correct. | ## Progress - **Fixed (was BLOCKING):** `renderContent` split changed from `.split(/\n\n+/)` to `.split(/\n+/)` — correctly handles single-newline `hast-util-to-string` output. - **Fixed (was BLOCKING):** `renderContent` escaping changed from `

{p}

` to `dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: p }}` — eliminates double HTML-entity encoding. - **Fixed (was WARNING):** Full ARIA tab semantics applied: `role="tablist"` on `.transcript-tab-bar`, `role="tab"` + `aria-selected` + `aria-controls` on buttons, `role="tabpanel"` + matching `id` on panels, `aria-selected` toggled in `afterDOMLoaded` script. - **Reviewer disagreement (resolved in synthesis):** The rubrics reviewer marked all four round-4 action items as resolved including the `ignorePatterns` addition. The claude reviewer correctly identified this as a new BLOCKING — `ignorePatterns` is applied at the glob stage, before `allFiles` is assembled, so caption files excluded here are invisible to `findText`. The claude reviewer's analysis is correct. - Resolved prior inline review thread on `Transcript.tsx` (split/escaping bugs — now fixed). - Posted new inline comment on [`quartz.config.ts` line 20](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/pull/41#discussion_r3246345583) flagging the BLOCKING `ignorePatterns` issue. ## Issue Details
ignorePatterns: ["captions"] silently breaks Transcript **Cause:** `ignorePatterns` is consumed by `quartz/build.ts:74`'s glob stage — files matching the pattern are never read, transformed, or included in `allFiles`. `Transcript.tsx`'s `findText` searches `allFiles` for a matching slug and returns `null` when not found. With caption files excluded, `findText` always returns `null`, the `if (!enText && !zhText) return null` guard always fires, and the component renders nothing silently regardless of frontmatter. `draft: true` has the same architectural incompatibility: `RemoveDrafts` runs before the emitter assembles `allFiles` (`contentPage.tsx:77`). **Candidate solutions:** - **Correct fix (minimal):** Remove `"captions"` from `ignorePatterns` in `quartz.config.ts`. The directory currently contains only `.gitkeep` — no indexable content — so there is no actual index pollution to guard against yet. - **Future-proof fix (caption-workflow PR):** When real caption files land, use a `ContentIndex`-level path filter (if available) or a custom Quartz filter plugin that passes caption files to `allFiles` for component lookups while suppressing their emission as standalone pages. **Comments:** The round-4 synthesis listed index exclusion as a WARNING that "can be addressed in the caption-workflow PR." The fix-pr agent addressed it preemptively but chose an approach that is architecturally incompatible with `allFiles`-based cross-file reads. The correct action was to leave `ignorePatterns` unchanged.
## Recommended Next Step `FIX_PR` — the blocking issue is a single-line revert in `quartz.config.ts` (`"captions"` removed from `ignorePatterns`); it is concrete, safe to automate, and unambiguous. ## Final Verdict **NEEDS_REWORK** ## Action Items - [ ] Remove `"captions"` from `ignorePatterns` in `quartz.config.ts` line 20 — revert the addition introduced by the fix-pr pass so caption files are visible to `allFiles` and `Transcript.tsx` can render them
